mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO PRODUCT_COMPARES (member_id, sku, created_at) SELECT #{memberId}, #{sku}, #{createdAt} FROM DUAL WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_COMPARES WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND sku <> #{sku}) < 4
mapper.select: SELECT c.sku, p.product_name AS productName, p.price, p.list_price AS listPrice, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.stock_qty AS stockQty, (p.stock_qty <= 0) AS soldOut, c.created_at AS comparedAt FROM PRODUCT_COMPARES c JOIN PRODUCTS p ON c.sku = p.sku WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.sku ASC
